title: Machine Learning-Assisted Evaluation of Topography-Dependent Cellular Responses in Meniscus-Mimetic Piezoelectric Nanofibrous Scaffolds.
authors: Kim, Jeong In; Kim, Minyoung; Lee, Soonchul; Lim, Claire Haeyoon; Choi, Wonchul; Lee, Sung-Sahn
one_liner_zh: 该文利用机器学习评估压电纳米纤维支架的拓扑结构对细胞反应的影响，核心是细胞-材料相互作用，而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Electrospun nanofibrous scaffolds provide topographical cues that regulate cellular behavior; however, relationships between scaffold design and multidimensional biological responses remain difficult to define because structural and material parameters act simultaneously. Here, we fabricated meniscus-mimetic piezoelectric nanofibrous scaffolds with different fiber architectures and compositions and systematically evaluated their cellular responses using machine learning (ML). Poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF)-based scaffolds with random, aligned, and radial fiber architectures were prepared, including composite scaffolds containing barium titanate (BaTiO(3)) and multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs). Scaffold morphology and fiber organization were quantitatively characterized, and mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) cultured on the scaffolds were analyzed by DAPI, F-actin, and SRY-box transcription factor 9 (SOX9) fluorescence imaging. Quantitative image analysis revealed scaffold-dependent differences in cellularity, nuclear morphology and orientation, cytoskeletal organization, and SOX9-associated phenotype, demonstrating distinct cellular responses to fiber topography and material composition. Scaffold and cellular parameters were subsequently integrated into a quantitative dataset to develop and compare multiple ML models for modeling scaffold-dependent cellular responses. The ML framework captured relationships between scaffold characteristics and multidimensional biological outcomes. These findings establish an experimental-computational approach for linking electrospun scaffold design with cellular behavior and provide a data-driven framework for the rational evaluation and optimization of meniscus-mimetic piezoelectric scaffolds.
abstract_zh: 电纺纳米纤维支架提供调节细胞行为的拓扑线索；然而，由于结构和材料参数同时作用，支架设计与多维生物学反应之间的关系仍难以界定。在此，我们制备了具有不同纤维结构和组成的半月板仿生压电纳米纤维支架，并使用机器学习（ML）系统评估了其细胞反应。制备了基于聚偏二氟乙烯（PVDF）的随机、对齐和径向纤维结构支架，包括含有钛酸钡（BaTiO(3)）和多壁碳纳米管（MWCNTs）的复合支架。定量表征了支架形态和纤维组织，并通过DAPI、F-actin和SRY-box转录因子9（SOX9）荧光成像分析了在支架上培养的间充质干细胞（MSCs）。定量图像分析揭示了支架依赖性差异，涉及细胞数量、核形态和取向、细胞骨架组织以及SOX9相关表型，表明细胞对纤维拓扑和材料组成有不同反应。随后，将支架和细胞参数整合为定量数据集，以开发和比较多种ML模型，用于建模支架依赖性细胞反应。ML框架捕捉了支架特征与多维生物学结果之间的关系。这些发现建立了一种将电纺支架设计与细胞行为联系起来的实验-计算方法，并为半月板仿生压电支架的合理评估和优化提供了数据驱动框架。
